lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 5-6 discernible vertical columns between the posterior gill slit and the start of the first dorsal fin, showing a decrease in density towards the posterior trunk.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pale bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with faint horizontal bands to form a grid-like matrix; the highest-intensity circular blobs are primarily localized at the nodal intersections of these intensity gradients.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance dorsal surfaces to shadowed ventral surfaces, running parallel from the post-branchial region toward the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 10-12 visible high-luminance blobs of irregular diameters, distributed across the central and basal surface of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, semi-random distribution of small high-luminance spots across its entire dorsal surface; two Echeneidae specimens are visible in the ventral field below the pectoral fin.
